title: Studies on Sign Language Retrieval in Low-Resource Dictionary Settings
abstract: arXiv:2611.16621v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most sign languages have no annotated corpus, only small dictionaries with one or a few example videos per sign. This study examines how well a pose encoder trained on a single sign language serves such languages without any target-language training.   An encoder trained with metric learning on American Sign Language (ASL-Citizen) is evaluated frozen on six datasets of Turkish, Russian, Indian, Argentinian, Pakistani and Sri Lankan sign languages, with one or four clips per sign enrolled and, where   signer identities are available, the query's signer excluded from the gallery. With one enrolled clip, the encoder retrieves the correct sign first in 36.4-80.7 % of queries, against 16.0-69.6 % for the best learning-free method (angle-based dynamic   time warping) and a six-target mean of 39.3 % for an ASL-trained OpenHands graph network. translated_title: 低资源词典设置下的手语检索研究
translated_abstract: 大多数手语缺乏带标注的语料库，仅有小型词典，每个手语词条只有一段或几段示例视频。本研究考察了仅在单一手语上训练的姿态编码器，能否在不对目标语言进行任何训练的情况下服务于这类手语。该编码器在美式手语数据集ASL-Citizen上以度量学习方式训练后以冻结状态进行评估，测试对象涵盖土耳其、俄罗斯、印度、阿根廷、巴基斯坦和斯里兰卡六种手语数据集；每个词条注册一段或四段视频片段，并且在可获得打手语者身份信息时，将查询者本人的视频从候选库中排除。在仅注册一段视频的情况下，该编码器在36.4%–80.7%的查询中首位即检索到正确手语；相比之下，最优的无学习方法（基于角度的动态时间规整）为16.0%–69.6%，而在美式手语上训练的OpenHands图网络在六个目标数据集上的平均准确率为39.3%。在对编码器的交叉消融研究中（嵌入几何结构、身体与手部嵌入的聚合方式、训练……（原文摘要在此处中断）
tldr: 仅在美式手语上通过度量学习训练的姿态编码器无需任何目标语言训练，即可在六种低资源手语的词典检索中取得36.4%–80.7%的首位命中率，显著优于无学习方法与OpenHands等基线方法。
en_tdlr: A pose encoder trained with metric learning only on American Sign Language transfers zero-shot to dictionary-scale retrieval in six other sign languages, achieving 36.4–80.7% top-1 accuracy with a single enrolled clip and outperforming learning-free DTW and OpenHands baselines.
